trailhead.label: Tennis du Mottet, Valmorel (official start; parking P4, P5 or P6)

cautions: Stone steps up to Plan Salin and a long switchback descent ('Les 51 virages').
Wet, shaded ground by the waterfalls; strongly advised against in rain or storms (official).
Mountain bikes may cross the path in the forest (official).
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
